sources.entry: Quackback | Open source feedback platform with voting boards, roadmaps, and changelogs

summary.one_liner: Quackback is an open-source, self-hostable customer feedback and support suite combining feedback boards, a public roadmap, changelog, support inbox, help center, status page, and AI agent.
summary.what_it_does: Provides feedback boards where customers post, vote and comment, with duplicate merging and moderation. It includes a public roadmap that links requests to trackers like Linear, GitHub and Jira, and a changelog that notifies voters by email and RSS. A shared support inbox handles live chat, email and tickets, alongside a searchable help center and a status page with incidents and maintenance windows. An embeddable widget covers feedback, chat, help articles and changelog, and a REST API, signed webhooks and an MCP server are offered for developers and AI agents.
use_cases: collect and vote on customer feature requests
run a shared support inbox with tickets and live chat
host a help center and status page
connect AI assistants to feedback and tickets via MCP
how_to_run: Local development: bun run setup, then bun run dev (requires Bun 1.4+ and Docker)
notable: Self-hosting includes every feature with unlimited seats and no license key
Linear and GitHub integrations update requests automatically as issues move
Serves an MCP server at /api/mcp for Claude, Cursor and other AI tools
Portal and widget support 10+ languages including right-to-left
Cloud code in the repo is inert on self-hosted installs with no control-plane requests
caveats: Self-hosted installs send one anonymous daily usage snapshot unless DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true is set
You must bring your own email and AI providers and run servers, backups and upgrades yourself
Local development requires Bun 1.4 or later and Docker
